translation_direction: ru → vi; direct from the specifically identified complete Russian electronic witness
ai_disclosure: Direct AI-produced Vietnamese prose by Claude Opus 5.5. The drafting system conducted the final full assessment; a separate-context assessment by the same model family read every pair and supplied findings first. No human translator, editor, reviewer, independent model consensus or actual reader feedback is recorded.

entry_conditions: Complete named-source and Vietnamese texts, explicit alignment and exact content hashes.
Compare every source and target passage; disclose that this assessor also revised the text and has seen earlier AI assessments.
Source and target edition titles are present and compared explicitly; the title review must match both catalog title strings exactly.
exit_conditions: One complete AI review with a weighted score at least 8.6 using the five unchanged weights and half-point category scores; no separate numerical dimension floors.
All canonical passages reviewed; no unresolved major or critical finding; source and target hashes match the final text.
Publication and rights status are recorded separately in the edition catalog; an AI score does not supply a license.
The selected review includes source_title, target_title and a substantive title rationale; changed titles require a fresh matching review.
review_process.human_feedback: Optional after publication or while a work remains a draft; no prior human publication review is required by v2.

decisions.decision: Chekhov’s elegy of unfulfilled longing is kept: the refrain of Moscow, the long pauses rendered as (Im lặng.), the officers’ easy talk and the sisters’ restless dreams stay faithful.
decisions.rationale: The play lives in its longing and its pauses.

decisions.decision: Paragraphs that the transcription leaves without a speaker are kept unlabelled rather than assigned a speaker.
decisions.rationale: Assigning speakers would invent attribution the transcription does not make.

revision_history.scope: Complete initial direct translation, separate-context full source/target assessment and concrete revisions before the selected final review.

changes.explanation: Masha’s sibling forms were reversed (she called herself “em” and Irina “chị”); corrected to chị/em in her speech.
Irina’s forms reversed as well; corrected.
A stage direction used “bà” for a woman whom the Russian only refers to as “к ней”; corrected.
The troika ride (“прокатиться”) was rendered as a walk; corrected to a drive.
The same troika ride in Natasha’s line; corrected.
Solyony’s “Мне все равно” (I don’t care) was rendered as “Tôi không sao”; corrected.
“Не дай бог” (God forbid) was rendered as “Chúa phù hộ”, reversing it; corrected.
Olga’s own refusal was given the sibling form of the addressee; corrected.
Tuzenbakh’s opening jibe at Masha was addressed to Irina; corrected.
Kozyrev’s boys’ gymnasium was rendered as a girls’ school; corrected to a boys’ school.
The addressee of “ты снесешь” was lost; corrected.
“Привык я к вам” (I have grown used to you) was rendered as the place; corrected to the sisters.
“Кому она нужна” reversed its dependency; corrected.
An invented rank class was removed from “надворный советник”.
In Act III, “не его дело” shifted the referent to Kulygin; corrected to the director.

selection_limit: Chosen for a complete, directly sourced and openly reusable Vietnamese edition. Existing Vietnamese translations, their quality and reader demand have not been comprehensively assessed; no absence or superiority claim is made.

glossary.rationale: The city name in the sisters’ refrain, one rendering throughout.

glossary.draft_rendering: Olga: chị to Masha and Irina; Irina: em to Olga, chị to Masha; Masha: chị to Irina
glossary.rationale: Olga is the eldest, Masha the middle, Irina the youngest.

glossary.draft_rendering: trường trung học nữ (girls); trường trung học nam (boys)
glossary.rationale: The school’s sex is kept consistent with the character.

witness_decision: Selected the Russian Wikisource transcription of Три сестры, the four acts in separate subpages, as the text the project could read directly; the project did not collate it with the 1901 first edition.

title_review.rationale: The title is rendered as ‘Ba chị em’ (The Three Sisters); no earlier Vietnamese title was checked.

passage_assessment_notes.assessment: The opening stage direction of Act I: the Prozorov drawing room at noon.
The last unit: the sisters’ final cry of longing.
